items.title: Aseprite Convert
items.description: Turn Aseprite files into Minecraft-ready PNG textures with sprite sheets, frame exports, and atlas-style layer splits.

items.title: Addon Docs
items.description: Generate clean Markdown docs from your add-on files using templates, so documentation stays up to date as you build.

items.title: Auto Spawn Egg
items.description: Automatically picks spawn egg colors from your entity textures, so custom mobs get matching eggs without manual color tuning.

items.title: Fetcher
items.description: Pull files or folders from GitHub straight into your project, great for shared scripts, templates, and external assets.

items.title: Image Mixer
items.description: Build many texture variants from layered PNGs using configurable positioning, scaling, and combination rules.

items.title: MCLocalize
items.description: Translate your .lang files into multiple languages to bootstrap localization, then refine the results before release.

items.title: Replacements
items.description: Run fast project-wide text replacements for namespaces and placeholders when starting, cloning, or rebranding packs.

items.title: Jsonify
items.description: Convert YAML, JSON5, JSONC, and TOML into standard JSON so your data pipeline stays Minecraft-tool friendly.

items.title: MultiFeature
items.description: Write multiple feature definitions in one source file and split them into Minecraft-ready JSON during build.

items.title: Recipe Image Gen
items.description: Automatically generate visual crafting recipe images from your recipe files for docs, wikis, and player guides.

items.title: Perlin Fiddle
items.description: Interactive browser tool for visualizing and tuning Perlin noise in real time. v2.0 features sandboxed code execution, seeded noise, shareable links, and a redesigned UI.

items.title: Controller View
items.description: VS Code extension that renders Minecraft Bedrock animation controller JSON files as an interactive state machine graph, with real-time updates and side-by-side editing.

items.title: ModularMC Syntax Highlight
items.description: VS Code extension adding syntax highlighting and IntelliSense for ModularMC — TypeScript inside JSON strings, template variable completion, and auto-map path resolution.

items.title: Bedrock Kit
items.description: Unofficial TypeScript SDK for reading and navigating Bedrock addon files. Bridges behavior and resource packs, supports reverse lookups, PBR textures, and cross-linked asset types.
